business_summary.text: Brightcom Group is a global technology-driven digital media company operating at the intersection of advertising, data, and intelligent monetization, with a diversified international footprint.

call_points.text: Management expects to sustain growth momentum with focus on operational excellence and capital allocation.
Global advertising market projected to reach USD 995.0B by 2033, with strong traction in CTV and gaming.
Improved platform relevance and monetization efficiency through 100% Fill Technology and server-side architecture.
Regulatory and legal proceedings are being actively managed with a structured framework.

timeline.summary: Brightcom Group announced that its subsidiary OMS successfully scaled Azerion's publisher network from approximately 11 to over 100 domains in six months.
Brightcom Group reported April 2026 monthly updates highlighting the scaling of Azerion's publisher network to over 100 domains and progress on its four-division structure.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,596.64 Cr (+61.7% YoY), PAT ₹207.83 Cr (+72.2% YoY).
Brightcom Group Limited’s **Raghu Allamsetty** (Executive Director) announced a shareholder conference call on **June 14, 2026**, to discuss FY 2025-26 results and business updates.
Brightcom Group FY25-26: Revenue up 34.6% YoY to ₹6,928 Cr; PAT up 35.5% to ₹962 Cr; launched four-division model including Brightcom Defence.
On August 14, 2026, Brightcom Group announced that its subsidiary OnoMagic acquired full ownership of digital publishing platform The Perspective.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,752.18 Cr (+20.4% YoY), net profit ₹261.58 Cr (+24.0% YoY).

Brightcom Group Limited, led by Executive Director Raghunath Allamsetty, announces a conference call for shareholders on September 4, 2026, at 4:30 p.m. IST to discuss Q1 FY27 results and business updates.
Brightcom Group Limited’s **Raghunath Allamsetty** corrected the shareholders’ conference call time to **4:30 p.m. IST** on **September 4, 2026**, due to prior communication errors.
